text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am fine. Although I am feeling just a little nervous—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that we're heading toward our goal from here
makes my heart soar with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The first step toward conquering the Tenno Sho.
...Now, let us take it!
